author: Sumdaddy
quote: For its time, the game was absolute perfection and the definition of what a video game adventure was all about…
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Sumdaddy
quote: Putting aside the cinema-tics, I believe GTA 6 launched too early and is not playable… I’m in no way saying this is a bad game but currently as it stands, it’s just playable… and to justify that they spent a billion dollars and couldn’t get the frame rate to at least 60fps is no excuse… I look forward to the updates to fix many issues so I can play the game, till then my review for the game stands.

author: Sumdaddy
quote: Characters are amazing, story is a classic and graphics are incredible… can’t believe it’s on a switch 2 and not a high end console…
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
